name: Fidelis Memory
tagline: Recall original notes from a local-first agent memory store
description: Fidelis gives Cline four MCP tools for faithful local memory recall, direct queries, service health, and context-sensitive orientation. Its default retrieval path does not call an LLM.

install.notes: Prerequisites: Python 3.10+, uv/uvx, and Ollama with the nomic-embed-text model. Before first use, run `uvx --from fidelis-memory==0.0.95 fidelis init` once to install and start the local Fidelis service. Remove that service with `uvx --from fidelis-memory==0.0.95 fidelis init --uninstall`.
